start_wave_pattern.name: Start wave pattern
start_wave_pattern.description: Runs a single wave (min_speed → max_speed → min_speed) on the targeted toy/toys, optionally repeated.

repeat.name: Repeat
repeat.description: How many times to repeat the single wave cycle.

min_speed.name: Min speed
min_speed.description: The wave's trough — its speed at the start and end of the cycle.

max_speed.name: Max speed
max_speed.description: The wave's peak — its speed at the midpoint of the cycle.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: How long one single wave (min → max → min) takes, in seconds.

start_pulse_pattern.name: Start pulse pattern
start_pulse_pattern.description: Runs a single pulse (a low phase followed by a high phase) on the targeted toy/toys, optionally repeated.

repeat.name: Repeat
repeat.description: How many times to repeat the single pulse cycle.

low_duration.name: Low duration
low_duration.description: How long the low phase lasts, in seconds.

high_duration.name: High duration
high_duration.description: How long the high phase lasts, in seconds.

stop_pattern.name: Stop pattern
stop_pattern.description: Stops any running pattern on the targeted toy/toys.
